description: Validation warnings for the precision-source fixtures (esm-spec §11.3.3 P8). `warnings` maps a fixture to the `(code, path)` of every entry of the validation result's non-unit `warnings` list, in any order; `unit_warnings` carries none of them. `legacy_version` is an esm version below the §11.3.3 gate: the same document declaring it has declared binary64 precision and draws no warning. All five bindings assert both.
